public.title: K Closest Points to Origin
public.description: Return the k closest points to the origin. Sort output by increasing squared distance; break ties by x coordinate and then y coordinate, both increasing. Duplicate points remain duplicated. points has 0 to 1000 integer coordinate pairs in -10000 to 10000, and k ranges from 0 to its length. Deterministic tie and output ordering are required.
hints: Apply all tie-breakers before taking the first k points.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Sort by the required numeric comparison tuple and take the first k points. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
